insights.summary: The agent performed a very high-quality systematic optimization. It proved the performance gain with a custom script and applied the requested pattern across all relevant serving files. The only significant flaw was the lack of git hygiene, resulting in a bloated patch file.
strengths: Excellent use of micro-benchmarking to justify changes.
Methodical search and replace across multiple files.
weaknesses: Failed to follow the 'only modify target files' constraint strictly in the final commit stage.
